integrity: Analytical proof with explicit external theorem dependency; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer dimensions d>=3; the positive critical gap is a conditionally convergent Bessel-difference integral, not a closed form; no uniform-in-d error bound. Uses the prior finite-q modal ordering and positive-cell lemma of arXiv:2610.19648. Finite quadrature is supplementary, not proof.
title: Critical fractional-power collapse of sharp spherical Fourier-extension stability
